name: Failure Reason 9 Code
definition: Incident occurring during the processing of an ATM transaction.

CDCP.name: Card Captured
CDCP.definition: ATM manager has requested to capture the card.

CDCL.name: Card Declined
CDCL.definition: Integrated circuit card declines the transaction before or after the authorisation.

CDER.name: Card Error
CDER.definition: Unable to complete transaction with the card.

CUCL.name: Customer Cancel
CUCL.definition: Customer cancellation, for example removing the card before the end of the transaction.

CUDC.name: Customer Decline
CUDC.definition: Customer has declined additional fees or a lower amount, transaction fails.

CDFG.name: Forgotten Card
CDFG.definition: Customer has left the card in the ATM or a motorised card reader.

FILL.name: Fullfilment Error
FILL.definition: Unable to fulfil, for instance dispensing the cash.

SECU.name: Security Error
SECU.definition: Security error has occurred in the authorisation response message sent by the acquirer.

SFRD.name: Suspected Fraud
SFRD.definition: Card payment transaction fails because the merchant suspect a fraud.

TIMO.name: Time Out
TIMO.definition: Timeout while waiting for a response to a request message, or no response was received (for example connection release before receiving the response).

LATE.name: Too Late Response
LATE.definition: Response to the previous message was received too late.

UCPT.name: Unable To Capture
UCPT.definition: Unable to capture the card as requested.

UCMP.name: Unable To Complete
UCMP.definition: Unable to complete the transaction after the authorisation response.

USND.name: Unable To Send
USND.definition: Unable to deliver the request message to the recipient party.

CSRV.name: Out Of Customer Service
CSRV.definition: ATM manager has requested to the ATM to stop customer services.

CDRT.name: Card Retained
CDRT.definition: Card has been retained by the ATM or the terminal.

CUTO.name: Customer Time Out
CUTO.definition: Customer has not been performed in time an action.

RJCT.name: Reject
RJCT.definition: The ATM Manager has sent an ATMReject message in response to an authorisation request.

FMTE.name: Format Error
FMTE.definition: The ATM Manager has sent a response message in response to an authorisation request where some of its required elements were badly formatted (for example an integer value where a dateTime value was expected).

VLTE.name: Validation Error
VLTE.definition: The ATM Manager has sent a response message in response to an authorisation request where some of its required elements were invalid (for example an incorrect ExchangeIdentifier).

CHFG.name: Cash Dispenser Retract
CHFG.definition: Following a cash dispense operation the consumer forgot to take the notes, which have subsequently been retracted following a Present time-out. The number of notes retracted is unknown.

DCFG.name: Cash Deposit Retract
DCFG.definition: Following a cash return, on a deposit operation, the consumer forgot to take the returned notes, causing them to be retracted. The number of notes retracted is unknown.

CQFG.name: Cheque Deposit Retract
CQFG.definition: Following cheques being returned, on a cheque deposit operation, the consumer forgot to take the returned cheques, causing them to be retracted. The number of cheques retracted is unknown.

DFGC.name: Cash Deposit Retract Counted
DFGC.definition: Following a cash return, on a deposit operation, the consumer forgot to take the returned notes, causing them to be retracted. The number of notes retracted is known as the device was able to count the notes retracted.

CFGC.name: Cash Dispenser Retract Counted
CFGC.definition: Following a cash dispense operation the consumer forgot to take the returned notes, which have subsequently been retracted following a Present time-out. The number of notes retracted is known as the device was able to count the notes retracted.

QFGC.name: Cheque Deposit Retract Counted
QFGC.definition: Following cheques being returned, on a cheque deposit operation, the consumer forgot to take the returned cheques, causing them to be retracted. The number of cheques retracted is known as the device was able to count the cheques retracted.

CQRT.name: Cheques Retained
CQRT.definition: Cheques have been retained by the terminal since it has been unable to return them.

DCRT.name: Deposits Retained
DCRT.definition: Cash has been retained by the terminal since it has been unable to return it.
